psalm_mapping_note: Identity of whole verses verified for these Vulgate psalms only. Other psalm verse numbering is unresolved; do not merely shift a chapter number.
mapping_note: Conservative scope: whole-verse identity only outside known uncollated versification differences. Checked passage exceptions cover Daniel 3 and Hebrew Psalm 100. Partial verse cuts are never inferred. Further mappings require collation.
